method: What each scored vault holds, rebuilt every 4-hour scoring run: markets, pools, strategies and tokens, how much of each, and for lending the collateral behind the loans (one market for Morpho, the pool mix for Aave, Euler and Kamino). Every holding names the contract call or API request it was read from; anything that could not be read is an explicit unknown holding, never a guess. coverage is the share of the vault traced to known tokens.
disclaimer: Research and information, not investment advice.
